title: Mixed Event — We Escape to Survive — Episode5 Unable To Face Facts

meta.Event Outline: With Mafuyu's contact with the group restricted, the rest of N25 think what they can do for her. Hoping to give her some peace of mind, Mizuki comes up with a plan...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I knew that Mafuyu wouldn't take it well... But I just blurted out what was on my mind...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sure Mafuyu understands that you're very worried about her, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We shouldn't let things take their course...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree with Mizuki in terms of setting up ways to meet with Mafuyu in person.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But if we do begin losing contact with her, she's going to have an incredibly tough time getting anything done for N25...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If she loses access to both her computer and phone... That means she'll also lose access to SEKAI...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She just keeps pushing Mafuyu further and further into a corner by taking everything that means anything to her daughter...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (First, her synthesizer gets tossed and now her computer's gone. The walls are really starting to close in on Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As much as we want to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What can we actually do about all this...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We discussed what's going on after that for hours, but we still couldn't come up with anything good...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What do we do...?
Time just keeps on slipping.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's even a chance that Mafuyu's gonna get her phone taken away when she gets home today...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We thought you went home already since you sorta disappeared during lunch!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: You know, if Mizuki doesn't like people pointing it out, why not just dress normally for school?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I know, right? Of course people are going to say things when you stand out like that.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's just the way Mizuki is, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Totally. Some people just don't know how to fit in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I was just heading home...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
We were just thinking about checking out this new shop that opened up by the station. Wanna come?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: They apparently have all your favorite cosmetic brands there, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Now's not really the time for this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hate to do this, but I need to just come up with an excuse and...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: We were also just talking about how we haven't spoken much with you recently and that it'd be fun to hang out together.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Things are definitely more fun when you're around, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: And spending time hanging out after school like this might make you want to come to school more, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(They weren't being mean that time.
They probably just didn't know...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They don't understand how hard it is sometimes to have to put on a face and not be yourself in order to “get along”...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Is something wrong? Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But if I told them now, they might understand...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
But there's something I need to take care of today.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Okay...
That's too bad, but we get it. Life happens.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: But we should totally go check it out together next time! We'll send pics of what we bought later!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks...
See ya and have fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Home sweet home...
The place where I can just relax and be myself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu can't even do that at her own house...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(At school or at home...
It's like she's suffering no matter where she is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In a way, that makes Mafuyu an amazingly strong girl...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, whenever I was faced with a tough situation...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
But there's something I need to take care of today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Come to think of it...
I've been doing that for as long as I can remember.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I ran from everything that I thought would cause me pain. I still want to even though I've found some friends that I really don't want to lose...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Which begs the question...
Am I capable of providing a place for someone to run?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Unlike Kanade and Ena, I've never really been able to deal with any of my own problems...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So, what right do I have to try and help someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Just as an update, the new demo's on schedule to be completed tomorrow. I'd like for us to listen to it together the day after tomorrow in SEKAI if Yuki's available to join us.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
My mind's not in a good place today...
I just keep latching onto the negatives.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I need... To chill out a bit...
